title: Remix Agreement
summary: Commission a remix of a track, with stems delivery, fee or royalty, credit, ownership of the remix master and approval.
useWhen: An artist or label hires a remixer, or approves a remix, for an official release.
watchOuts: The remixer usually gets no share of the composition. The original writers own the song. If the remixer adds new melodies or lyrics, decide in writing whether they get a writer share and whether publishers approve.
The original owner must control the master and have the right to authorize remixes, including featured artists' approvals.
If the remixer adds samples, they must be cleared.

Under U.S. copyright law, a work by a non-employee is a 'work made for hire' only if it falls within one of nine statutory categories (such as a contribution to a collective work or part of an audiovisual work) and the parties sign a written agreement saying so. A stand-alone sound recording or beat is often not in those categories, which is why this template also includes a written assignment.

variables.label: Remix royalty (% of net income from the remix master)
Remixer gets a composition share?
variables.help: Only if they add new written material and the writers and publishers agree.

variables.label: Remixer may play the remix in DJ sets before release?
Governing law (state)
variables.help: Two-letter code of the state whose law governs this agreement. Usually where the parties or the work are located.

sections.title: 1. Parties and track
sections.body: Rights owner: {{owner_name}}. Remixer: {{remixer_name}} ({{remixer_alias}}). Original track: {{original}}. Date: {{agreement_date}}.

sections.title: 2. Stems and delivery
sections.body: Rights owner will deliver stems by {{stems_date}}. Remixer will deliver a final remix (WAV, plus instrumental and stems on request) by {{deadline}}. Rights owner may request reasonable revisions and may reject the remix in its discretion. If rejected, Remixer keeps any fee already paid and may not release the remix.

sections.title: 3. Payment
sections.body: Payment: {{comp_type}}. Fee: {{fee}}, paid within 15 days after Rights owner accepts the remix.

sections.title: 4. Royalty
sections.body: Rights owner will also pay Remixer {{royalty_percent}}% of Rights owner's net income from the remix master, accounted twice a year with statements.

sections.title: 5. Ownership
sections.body: The remix master is a work made for hire for Rights owner to the extent the law allows. Otherwise Remixer assigns all rights in the remix master and Remixer's contributions to Rights owner. Rights owner may release, edit and license it. Remixer: [[initial:remixer]]

sections.title: 6. Composition
sections.body: Remixer gets no ownership of the composition, unless the next section applies.

sections.title: 7. Composition share
sections.body: Remixer added new written material. With the original writers' and publishers' written approval, Remixer will receive {{writer_share_percent}}% of the composition of the remix version only, recorded in a split sheet.

sections.title: 8. Credit
sections.body: The remix will be titled "{{original}} ({{remixer_alias}} Remix)" where the platform allows, and Remixer will be credited in metadata.

sections.title: 9. DJ use
sections.body: Before release, Remixer may play the remix in live DJ sets, but may not share files, upload or stream it.

sections.title: 10. Confidentiality
sections.body: Remixer will keep the stems and unreleased remix confidential, will not share or upload them, and will delete the stems after delivery unless Rights owner agrees otherwise.

sections.title: 11. Promises
sections.body: Remixer promises that its contribution is original, or that every sample, interpolation or third-party element in it has been disclosed in writing and is either cleared or will be cleared before release. Remixer has not granted rights that conflict with this agreement.

sections.title: 12. General terms
sections.body:
- **Whole agreement.** This document (with any attachments named in it) is the parties' entire agreement on its subject and replaces earlier discussions and drafts.
- **Changes.** It can only be changed in a writing signed by all parties.
- **Severability.** If a court finds any part unenforceable, that part is limited to the minimum extent needed and the rest stays in effect.
- **No waiver.** Not enforcing a term once is not a waiver of it later.
- **Notices.** Notices must be in writing and delivered by hand, by a recognized courier, by certified mail, or by email to the addresses in this document (or a later address a party gives in writing). Email notice is effective when sent unless the sender receives a bounce-back.
- **Governing law.** The law of the state of {{governing_state}} governs this agreement, without regard to conflict-of-law rules.
- **Counterparts and electronic signatures.** This agreement may be signed in counterparts and electronically. Each party consents to doing business electronically under the federal E-SIGN Act and the state's version of the Uniform Electronic Transactions Act (or New York's Electronic Signatures and Records Act). An electronic signature has the same effect as a handwritten one.

sections.title: Signatures
sections.body:
By signing below, each party agrees to this document.

**Rights owner** — {{owner_name}}

[[sig:owner]]

Printed name: [[name:owner]]
Title (if signing for a company): [[text:owner:Title]]
Date: [[date:owner]]

**Remixer** — {{remixer_name}}

[[sig:remixer]]

Printed name: [[name:remixer]]
Date: [[date:remixer]]

disclaimer: This is a starting template from the Chucksi open contract library. It is not legal advice, and using it does not create an attorney-client relationship. Laws vary by state and change over time. Have a licensed attorney in your state review it before you sign. Music rights are split between the composition (song) and the sound recording (master); royalties also depend on PRO, publisher, distributor and label agreements that this template does not change. An entertainment attorney should review deals involving advances, ownership transfers or long terms.
